title: Pricing Part A Coinsurance Days in a Notice-Billed Month — Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
For a month billed on the County Assistance Office notice under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, the price of each Part A coinsurance day (benefit days 21 through 100 booked for the month, less those reversed) follows who is billed the coinsurance for that month on the resident's Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage billing record.

**Formal clause.** The price of a Part A coinsurance day in an actual-billed month follows who is billed the coinsurance for the month: where the month's coinsurance is billed to the Medigap carrier or the resident and none of it to the Medical Assistance program as crossover payer, nothing, since the Medigap plan and the resident bear that coinsurance and the Medicare billing record charges it to them; where it is billed to the program as crossover payer and the highest daily coinsurance booked for the month is above the Medicaid daily rate, the Medicaid daily rate, since the program's crossover payment for a day never exceeds what it pays for a Medicaid day; otherwise the highest daily coinsurance booked for the month.

**Decision table.**

| Coinsurance charges on the Medicare billing record for the month | Highest daily coinsurance booked for the month compared with the Medicaid daily rate | Price of each coinsurance day |
|---|---|---|
| to the Medigap carrier or the resident, none to Medical Assistance as crossover payer | any | 0.00 |
| at least one to Medical Assistance as crossover payer | above the daily rate | the Medicaid daily rate |
| at least one to Medical Assistance as crossover payer | equal to or below the daily rate | the highest daily coinsurance booked |
| no coinsurance charge recorded for the month | any | the highest daily coinsurance booked |

**Hypothetical cases** (highest daily coinsurance booked 209.50 dollars):
- Coinsurance billed only to a Medigap carrier: each coinsurance day is priced at 0.00.
- Coinsurance billed to Medical Assistance as crossover payer on a case whose Medicaid daily rate is 205.90 dollars: 209.50 is above 205.90, so each coinsurance day is priced at 205.90.
- Same crossover billing on a case whose Medicaid daily rate is 268.40 dollars: 209.50 is not above 268.40, so each day is priced at 209.50.
